CustomField.description: Join-barrier counter for parallel Tier 4 dedup shards (C). Seeded by Tier3DispatchQueueable with the number of concurrent Tier3AgenticBatch shards; each shard's finish() decrements it under FOR UPDATE. The shard that decrements it to 0 is the last one done and enqueues KBAssessmentPipelineCallback. Null means the single-lane legacy path (Tier3AgenticQueueable fires the callback directly).
CustomField.label: Tier 4 Lanes Outstanding
